riemann_hypothesis.name: Riemann Hypothesis
riemann_hypothesis.description: All non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function have real part 1/2
riemann_hypothesis.description_cn: 黎曼ζ函数的所有非平凡零点的实部都等于 1/2

p_vs_np.name: P vs NP Problem
p_vs_np.description: Is every problem whose solution can be verified quickly also solvable quickly?
p_vs_np.description_cn: 每个可以快速验证解的问题是否也可以快速求解？

navier_stokes.name: Navier-Stokes Existence and Smoothness
navier_stokes.name_cn: 纳维 - 斯托克斯方程存在性与光滑性
navier_stokes.description: Prove existence and smoothness of solutions to the 3D Navier-Stokes equations
navier_stokes.description_cn: 证明三维纳维 - 斯托克斯方程解的存在性和光滑性

hodge_conjecture.name: Hodge Conjecture
hodge_conjecture.description: Every Hodge class on a projective complex manifold is a rational linear combination of algebraic cycles
hodge_conjecture.description_cn: 射影复流形上的每个霍奇类都是代数圈的有理线性组合

yang_mills.name: Yang-Mills Existence and Mass Gap
yang_mills.name_cn: 杨 - 米尔斯存在性与质量间隙
yang_mills.description: Prove existence of Yang-Mills theory with a mass gap
yang_mills.description_cn: 证明存在质量间隙的杨 - 米尔斯理论

birch_swinnerton_dyer.name: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
birch_swinnerton_dyer.description: The rank of an elliptic curve equals the order of vanishing of its L-function at s=1
birch_swinnerton_dyer.description_cn: 椭圆曲线的秩等于其 L-函数在 s=1 处的零点阶数

poincare_conjecture.name: Poincare Conjecture
poincare_conjecture.description: Every simply connected closed 3-manifold is homeomorphic to the 3-sphere
poincare_conjecture.description_cn: 每个单连通的闭 3-流形都同胚于 3-球面

goldbach.name: Goldbach's Conjecture
goldbach.description: Every even integer greater than 2 is the sum of two primes
goldbach.description_cn: 每个大于 2 的偶数都可以表示为两个素数之和

twin_prime.name: Twin Prime Conjecture
twin_prime.description: There are infinitely many pairs of primes that differ by 2
twin_prime.description_cn: 存在无穷多对相差 2 的素数

collatz.name: Collatz Conjecture
collatz.description: The Collatz sequence always reaches 1 for any positive starting integer
collatz.description_cn: 考拉兹序列从任何正整数开始最终都会到达 1

abc_conjecture.name: ABC Conjecture
abc_conjecture.description: For any epsilon>0, there exists K_epsilon such that for all coprime a+b=c, c < K_epsilon * rad(abc)^(1+epsilon)
abc_conjecture.description_cn: 对任意epsilon>0，存在 K_epsilon使得对所有互素的 a+b=c，有 c < K_epsilon * rad(abc)^(1+epsilon)

homological_mirror_symmetry.name: Homological Mirror Symmetry Conjecture
homological_mirror_symmetry.description: The derived category of coherent sheaves on a Calabi-Yau is equivalent to the Fukaya category of its mirror
homological_mirror_symmetry.description_cn: 卡拉比 - 丘流形上的凝聚层导出范畴等价于其镜像的 Fukaya 范畴

langlands_full.name: Full Langlands Correspondence
langlands_full.description: Establish the full functoriality and reciprocity in the Langlands program
langlands_full.description_cn: 建立朗兰兹纲领中的完整函子性和互反律

smooth_4d_poincare.name: Smooth 4D Poincare Conjecture
smooth_4d_poincare.name_cn: 光滑 4 维庞加莱猜想
smooth_4d_poincare.description: Every smooth homotopy 4-sphere is diffeomorphic to the standard 4-sphere
smooth_4d_poincare.description_cn: 每个光滑同伦 4-球面都微分同胚于标准 4-球面

jacobian_conjecture.name: Jacobian Conjecture
jacobian_conjecture.description: A polynomial map with constant non-zero Jacobian determinant is invertible
jacobian_conjecture.description_cn: 雅可比行列式为非零常数的多项式映射是可逆的
